scope: Open source-selected SUCC pi/rh gates plus structural and hostile instruments; not all conceivable mathematical detectors

instruments.name: R0 origin-phase click
instruments.source: BBP exact zero U+Green
instruments.gate: liminf p>0
instruments.blindspot: Positive clicks at finitely many epochs do not prove all-epoch margin

instruments.name: R1 one-mode two-time phase collision
instruments.source: BBP exact zero U+Green
instruments.gate: limsup |W_B(1)|<1
instruments.blindspot: R0 can hold while R1 fails (periodic 1/15)

instruments.name: CH first hexadecimal digit-change
instruments.source: Original source digits/carries
instruments.gate: positive liminf rate, equivalently Re W_B(15)<1
instruments.blindspot: Does not imply CH_k for other k or full normality

instruments.name: CH_k periodic digit-change
instruments.source: Original source certified hex words
instruments.gate: positive liminf, equivalently Re W_B(16^k-1)<1
instruments.blindspot: A fixed k is strictly weaker than all k and normality

instruments.name: All-k period-escape / atomic-exclusion
instruments.source: Source orbit and radix digit sequence
instruments.gate: No finite-supported shell limit; all-mode anti-locking
instruments.blindspot: Anti-locking does not force positive entropy or normality

instruments.name: Parity source-sign/complement conditional Haar
instruments.source: Original 2/odd CRT prime and real winding
instruments.gate: real hexadecimal parity balance
instruments.blindspot: Prime marginal m alone does not pay beta_star

instruments.name: Restricted denominator near-locking

instruments.gate: v_16(x)<1 necessary for R0
instruments.blindspot: Even a strong exponent bound does not imply digit changes

instruments.name: All-word cylinder-count probe
instruments.source: Original zero-source hex words
instruments.gate: base-16 normality
instruments.blindspot: No single fixed word length is complete

instruments.name: All-h signed quadrature click
instruments.source: Source original completed phase
instruments.gate: W_B(h)->0 for each h!=0
instruments.blindspot: Single h or one quadrature insufficient

instruments.name: Oily-Gamma ALL-HARMONIC pair detector
instruments.source: Original source phase + declared conditional Oily2 frequency sampler
instruments.gate: C_B->0 iff normality
instruments.blindspot: Oily frequency index is chosen probe grammar, not BBP physical mode coupling

instruments.name: All-depth source Haar collision detector
instruments.source: Original zero-source 16-child future digit cylinders
instruments.gate: H_B->0 iff normality
instruments.blindspot: Low-depth balance can coexist with deterministic locked deeper digits

instruments.name: Gram/Fejer matrix purity
instruments.source: Source U_n or completed z_n
instruments.gate: prescribed growing H with energy->0 suffices
instruments.blindspot: Generic positivity and prescribed source width do not prove decay

instruments.name: Signed Basel/Omega six-frame trace
instruments.source: Original zero BBP, signed n^-2 height weights
instruments.gate: all fixed h zero iff normality
instruments.blindspot: Unphased Basel energy only gives O(1/A), not o(1/A)

instruments.name: Canonical future-conditioned child Haar details
instruments.source: Source zero certified digit cylinders and 15 character modes
instruments.gate: all guarded details->0 iff normality
instruments.blindspot: Just first-child/root detail is insufficient

instruments.name: Haar interval Wasserstein defect D
instruments.source: Source original empirical orbit mu_N, Q=C*T_push
instruments.gate: D_N->0 iff equidistribution; shell thresholds sufficient R0/CH
instruments.blindspot: Q is idempotent, not strict contraction

instruments.name: Signed chronological two-block CDF overlap
instruments.source: Source original two neighboring epochs
instruments.gate: uniform signed overlap bound + late defect control sufficient
instruments.blindspot: Omega_M>=0 algebra does not yield any lower margin

instruments.name: Conductor-flat Fejer innovation
instruments.source: Source U_n exact common denominator conductor Q_n
instruments.gate: limsup J_flat<=0 at prescribed H sufficient
instruments.blindspot: Arithmetic birth removal does not control flat-step signed mass

instruments.name: Resonant original-history lag collision
instruments.source: Original U_n(0) and four-pole r
instruments.gate: signed lag-family saving possibly implies weaker gates
instruments.blindspot: Compensating full inherited phase makes seed-blind innovation

instruments.name: Gamma causal-face Mellin phase

instruments.response: M(m(1+i lambda))/M(m) and higher k faces

instruments.name: Zero-child seed-cylinder energy microscope

instruments.gate: deep K=N-o(N) energy->0 iff Weyl mode

instruments.name: Mixed 2->3 joining Fourier interference
instruments.source: Original ratio-fiber source clock and completed real phases

instruments.name: Prime-sign conditional complement contrast
instruments.source: Original prime-power sign, global CRT/carry/tail
instruments.gate: beta->0 plus m->0 implies parity balance
instruments.blindspot: Perfect regression fit can coexist with wrong parity

instruments.name: Zero-anchor / carry source passport
instruments.source: Original r(n), U_0=0, exact tails and windings
instruments.gate: authenticates the selected source
instruments.blindspot: Source authentication by itself does not imply statistical cancellation

instruments.name: Complete finite-height zero count
instruments.source: Authentic xi(s) and argument principle

instruments.name: Completed signed Weil-quadratic sign
instruments.source: Authentic prime powers, archimedean gamma, poles and Schwartz domain
instruments.gate: RH iff Q_W(v)>=0 for all valid v
instruments.blindspot: Positive Gram or partial Gamma term is not genuine completed Q_W

instruments.name: Countably dense Weil negative-witness randomizer
instruments.source: Same original completed Weil form and dense allowable test family
instruments.gate: RH false iff positive negative-witness probability
instruments.blindspot: Nonnegative finite samples cannot prove zero probability

instruments.name: Li coefficients signed positivity
instruments.source: Original completed xi(s), proper analytic continuation
instruments.gate: RH iff lambda_n>0 for all n
instruments.blindspot: No finite Li list proves all-degree signs

instruments.name: Lagarias divisor-sum inequalities
instruments.source: Actual integer divisor source, H_n with exp/log
instruments.gate: RH iff strict negative for all n>=2
instruments.blindspot: Arbitrary finite inequalities do not give all-n bound

instruments.name: de Bruijn-Newman heat boundary
instruments.source: Original xi theta/Gamma Fourier heat source
instruments.gate: RH iff Lambda=0 using known Lambda>=0
instruments.blindspot: Every negative heat parameter already has off-real zeros irrespective of RH

instruments.name: First genuine prime-power Weil wavefront
instruments.source: Original Suzuki Q with q=2 onset and complete Gamma
instruments.response: supported subspace Q_W(v), signed prime jet
instruments.gate: local positive/negative spectral constraints
instruments.blindspot: Operator-norm prime birth and local positivity do not imply full RH
